message: No detected input validation: The load_data function reads files and processes data without any schema checks, dtype assertions, shape validations, or value-range guards on the loaded features, labels, or graph structure.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded directly from local filesystem paths via tf.io.gfile without any checksum verification, signature validation, or source authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: The code loads and transforms labels without any distribution comparison, validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: Feature preprocessing only applies StandardScaler normalization; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code constructs the GCN model from scratch and does not load any pretrained weights or serialized model files, so no integrity verification (hash check, signature, pinned revision) is present or needed in this path.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous label distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism is used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or any FGSM/PGD perturbation logic anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although train/val/test splits are created, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and the code explicitly reassigns y_test to y_val (line: y_test, test_mask = y_val, val_mask) collapsing the held-out test set into the validation set, undermining proper isolation; additionally only a sin
No detected input sanitization: The inference path (test function and main) directly converts raw numpy arrays to tensors without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are passed directly to argmax and then to sklearn metrics with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation on the logits/predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) for node classification, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
